definition.quantity: Elapsed handling plus completion work per synthetic request

handling.quantity: Elapsed handling duration per included request

completion.quantity: Completion work duration per included request

definition.population: Synthetic completed requests in the study roster
definition.boundary: One synthetic service team; request-level logged work only

aggregation.basis: Median of per-request sums; each request has equal weight

exclusions: Exclude synthetic test requests and retain exclusion counts
definition.window: Synthetic study day; include requests completed at or after 00:00 and before the next 00:00 UTC
definition.sampling: Census of the synthetic roster using the same event log and clock convention
conditions: Handling and completion intervals do not overlap
Missing timestamps are reported; no zero duration is imputed
definition.uncertainty: Synthetic authored durations; no field calibration or observed precision claimed

SyntheticSpec.locator: Authored synthetic fixture in this repository
SyntheticSpec.basis: Proposed checker example; no real operational or clinical claim
